description: This file is a test script for the 'git update-index' command, specifically testing how it handles paths with potential conflicts or nonsense paths within the repository cache. It creates various files and symlinks, performs update-index operations, and verifies expected success or failure outcomes.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites such as the availability of symlinks support.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Main Git command used to update the index with specified paths.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

calls: git update-index --add -- path0 path1 path2/file2 path3/file3
